QuestInfo.name: Spirit's Defile
QuestInfo.1:
Feng sent word that he discovered the Devil Clan's base.
You should go to where he is right away.
QuestInfo.2:
Tucked away in Spirit's Defile, the Devil Clan had their base in Jianghu this whole time. 
Only one entrance exists. Once you go inside, you will be able find Yun Wu and take revenge on those who assaulted the Xuanshan School. 
Feng advised you to come back prepared, with your brothers and sisters, but you couldn't risk their safety. You decided to end this yourself.
